thought.text: Database is seeded (events=11, news=10, poi=35). Keycloak worked end-to-end (the seeder authenticated through it). Let me confirm the realm via the proxy, then restart the dev servers.

reasoning_content: The database is correctly seeded (11 events, 10 news items, 35 POIs). Keycloak doesn't have curl inside it, but the realm was imported (I confirmed the realm import in the just up logs, and the sample-data-loader succeeded in authenticating via Keycloak to seed the data, which proves that Keycloak's login/authentication is working end-to-end). Let's verify the Keycloak realm via the proxy.

action.command:
echo "=== Keycloak realm urbo via proxy ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /realms/urbo: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/urbo
echo "=== Keycloak login page (realm) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /realms/urbo/protocol/openid-connect/auth: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/urbo/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=urbo-frontend&redirect_uri=http://app.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== meilisearch indexed docs ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-meilisearch-1 wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:7700/keys 2>/dev/null | head -c 60 || echo "(no wget)"
